notes: demo_sheet is what the published 1.1 page reads; it is never migrated in place. v2_sheet is the copy phase A migrated to the ledger model (Accounts, Entries, Balances, Contracts, Decisions, Rules); the page cuts over to it in phase C. v2_feed_url stays null until the copy's bound Apps Script is deployed as a web app (Extensions > Apps Script > Deploy); until then data/snapshot-v2.json is refreshed from connector reads with tools/grid_to_snapshot.py. staging_url is the private phase B artifact built against v2_sheet (title "The Kitty v2 staging"); the v2 build points its QR code there until phase C cuts the public page over, when the key goes.
